name: Basic Chemical Industries Company
summary: Basic Chemical Industries Company (BCI), founded in 1973 and based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, operates as a key manufacturer and supplier of chemical products, primarily within the Kingdom. Its operations are structured across two main divisions: Chemicals, and Adhesives and Other Materials. BCI offers a diverse portfolio of products, including hydrochloric acid, caustic soda, chlorine gas, sodium hypochlorite, and polyurethane chemicals, alongside ferric chloride, hot and cold melt adhesives, and sulfuric acid, which serve numerous industrial applications. Beyond manufacturing, the company's activities span the full chemical supply chain, encompassing sourcing, formulation, processing, international trade (import and export), marketing, distribution, and acting as an agent for chemical sales.
